projects.title: Sphero Swarm
projects.description: Leading a team of 4 members to develop mobile app using Flutter for control an interactive exhibit using bluetooth at a local museum.

projects.title: Drone Delivery
projects.description: Working within a team of 3 to develop dashboard for managing a drone delivery system including tracking drones real time and creating flight paths. Utilizing SolidJS, CesiumJS, Hasura, GraphQL.

projects.title: Electricity Sustainability and Consumption Analysis
projects.description: A detailed analysis of the school's electricity usage and examination of monetary savings from the installation of solar panels, LED lights, and the conduction of electricity reduction campaigns. This was followed by an extensive report on further sustainability measures that can be implemented. Received certificate of merit from the President of India.

projects.title: Tony Airways
projects.description: A mobile app for a dummy airline to find flights and book them, prebook wheelchair access, and generate boarding passes. Conferred 1st prize out of 20+ teams at CORE Creative.

projects.title: Byld
projects.description: A web app and algorithm to recommend base templates for residential buildings in the metaverse. Recommends designs based on user preferences and responses. Awarded 1st prize out of 25+ teams at MINET Make.

projects.title: Visarkh
projects.description: Designed a business that will outfit houses with energy efficeint and monitoring appliances. Developed an algorithm to optimize electricity usage and consumption based on costs and time of day.

projects.title: InTech Encryptid 2022
projects.description: Developed platform to host annual cryptic hunt. All data is fetched in real time from Notion DB. Implemented leaderboard and user authentication.

projects.title: Metaworks
projects.description: Metaverse-inspired game that simulates a real-world office environment. Players complete tasks, can buy powerups and compete against their friends for prizes Awarded 1st prize out of 20+ teams at Ncrypt 2022.

projects.title: Rydo
projects.description: A web app where users can find car pool for daily or occasional purposes. Implemented group chat and leaderboard with rewards. Awarded 1st prize out of 15+ teams at Dexterity

projects.title: CBSE 2.0
projects.description: Developed a web app for schools of the future. Has an online QA forum, AI enabled doubt answering, quiz and assignment submission, and more. Awarded 3rd prize out of 20+ teams at CORE Creative.

projects.title: Smart Dashboard
projects.description: Developed a dummy dashbaord for cars. Has real time weather updates, navigation, music player, calendar and emergency calling. Uses: GCAL API, OpenWeather API, SpotifyAPI, Twilio API

projects.title: The Good Place
projects.description: A mobile app that helps users cope with mental health issues. Has a mood journal, recommends playlists based on mood, emergency notification, and a space for users to provide advice to others and to vent.
